stem.text: The graph shows oxygen dissociation curves of adult oxyhaemoglobin in different carbon dioxide concentrations, 1 and 2.

stem.alt: Graph of percentage saturation of haemoglobin with oxygen against partial pressure of oxygen in kPa, with two curves labelled 1 and 2.

stem.text: Which conditions could change the shape of curve 1 to the shape of curve 2?

A.text: high carbon dioxide concentration causing a decrease in pH

B.text: high carbon dioxide concentration causing an increase in pH

C.text: low carbon dioxide concentration causing a decrease in pH

D.text: low carbon dioxide concentration causing an increase in pH
